title: O*NET 15-1252.00 Software Developers

excerpts.text: Research, design, and develop computer and network software or specialized utility programs. Analyze user needs and develop software solutions, applying principles and techniques of computer science, engineering, and mathematical analysis. Update software or enhance existing software capabilities.
Analyze user needs and software requirements to determine feasibility of design within time and cost constraints.
Develop or direct software system testing or validation procedures, programming, or documentation.
Modify existing software to correct errors, adapt it to new hardware, or upgrade interfaces and improve performance.
Working with Computers — Using computers and computer systems (including hardware and software) to program, write software, set up functions, enter data, or process information.

labeled_tasks.statement: Analyze user needs and software requirements to determine feasibility of design within time and cost constraints.
labeled_tasks.output: Feasibility judgment and scoped design options
labeled_tasks.success_criteria: A decision is documented with time, cost, and constraint tradeoffs.

labeled_tasks.statement: Develop or direct software system testing or validation procedures, programming, or documentation.
labeled_tasks.output: Tests, validation notes, or documented procedures
labeled_tasks.success_criteria: Failures are caught before they reach customers, or residual risk is explicit.

labeled_tasks.statement: Modify existing software to correct errors, adapt it to new hardware, or upgrade interfaces and improve performance.
labeled_tasks.success_criteria: The defect or constraint is resolved without silent regressions.

labeled_skills.name: python
labeled_skills.description: Write and review production Python in a small startup team.

labeled_skills.name: software design
labeled_skills.description: Turn ambiguous product needs into feasible software designs.

labeled_skills.name: software testing
labeled_skills.description: Validate software behavior with tests and explicit residual risk.

labeled_skills.name: debugging
labeled_skills.description: Diagnose and correct defects in existing systems.
